name: Tree, aerial
description: Tree crowns stay closed when seen from above (flight, drone): 3 vertical cards plus 3 crown planes pictured from the top, 1024 px. Identical copies are baked once. Colour bleeds into every transparent texel (padding full). Leaf area is kept in the smaller mipmaps; coverage mips only take effect with .dds output.
select_hint: Select the trees; copies of one tree share one atlas.
